title: The Road to Kano
text_content: Uncle Musa drives a big bus on the long road to Kano. During the holiday, Ngozi was allowed to travel with him for the first time. They left early in the morning, before the sun was high. Ngozi sat by the window and watched the farms and villages pass by. At noon, the bus stopped so that all could rest and eat. Ngozi bought roasted corn from a woman who sold food by the road. Later that afternoon, dark clouds rolled across the sky and heavy rain began to fall. The road became slippery, so Uncle Musa slowed down and drove carefully. Suddenly, a huge tree had fallen across the road ahead. Uncle Musa stopped the bus in time, and the passengers gasped in surprise. Some men climbed down and worked as a team to drag the branches away. Ngozi was very proud of her uncle, because his careful driving had kept everyone safe. When they reached Kano that night, she told her mother the whole story.
